faq_heading: Homes near Delview Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Delview Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Delview Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Delview Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Delview Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Gibson Elementary (0.2 km south-west), Annieville Elementary (0.5 km north-west) and Home Quest (0.5 km north-west).

Delview Secondary is a secondary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 9111 116 St. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Delview Secondary.
How the Delview Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Delview Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Delview Secondary

23 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Delview Secondary in a straight line (17 elementary, 5 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Gibson Elementary, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Jarvis Traditional Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is L.A. Matheson Secondary (1.6 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (0.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Devon Gardens Elementary (0.9 km). Other secondary schools close by: L.A. Matheson Secondary (1.6 km north-east), Delta Continuing Education (1.7 km south), North Delta Secondary (1.7 km south), Sands Secondary (2.5 km south-west), Continuing Ed SD36 (Invergarry) (2.6 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is L.A. Matheson Secondary, 1.6 km north-east of Delview Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Delview Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Delview Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Delview Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at L.A. Matheson Secondary, the nearest other secondary school, 1.6 km north-east of Delview Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
